title: A Full List of Current 2026-2027 Las Vegas Residencies (Updating)
summary: Catch a show in Las Vegas, including concert dates, artists performing and where to buy affordable tickets online.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

It’s been a great year in live music with a number of hot tours and music festivals in the books. However, there’s still plenty of time this year to go out and take in great live music performances and experiences, and there’s no place hotter than Las Vegas.

Some of music’s biggest stars, such as Backstreet Boys , have extended their Las Vegas Sphere residencies with new dates, like John Mayer Live at Sphere , as well as other hot recording artists, including BLACKPINK’S Lisa , Carín León, Metallica, Marc Anthony, Jeezy and others heading to “Sin City” in 2026. In fact, even The Eagles are back for one last run again.

Shop Las Vegas Residency Tickets at Ticketmaster

Tickets to Las Vegas residencies first went on sale through Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets — if they’re unable to attend.

However, residency dates have either sold out, or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find tickets online is through third-party retailers, such as StubHub , SeatGeek , Vivid Seats , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All retailers guarantee authentic tickets delivered in time before concerts start. Prices may also be above or below face value at times.
